title: Sing a Song
description: Sing your favorite song for 20 seconds.

title: Dance Off
description: Do your best dance move for the group.

title: Tell a Joke
description: Tell a joke. If nobody laughs, spin again.

title: Act Like a Cat
description: Crawl on the floor and meow for 15 seconds.

title: Staring Contest
description: Have a staring contest with the person to your left.

title: Rap Battle
description: Make up a 10-second rap about the person across from you.

title: Yoga Pose
description: Hold a yoga tree pose for 30 seconds without falling.

title: Beatbox
description: Give us your best 10-second beatbox performance.

title: Alphabet Backwards
description: Recite the alphabet backward as fast as you can.

title: Impersonation
description: Impersonate a famous celebrity until someone guesses them.

title: Thumb Wrestling
description: Win a thumb war against the player of your choice.

title: Hold Your Breath
description: Hold your breath for 20 seconds.

title: Spelling Bee
description: Spell a difficult word chosen by the group.

title: Juggling Act
description: Try to juggle 3 small items for 5 seconds.

title: No Blinking
description: Keep your eyes completely open for 30 seconds.

title: Foreign Language
description: Speak only in a fake made-up language for one minute.

title: Animal Noises
description: Make 5 different animal noises in a row.

title: Arm Wrestling
description: Arm wrestle the person on your right.

title: Poetry Reading
description: Recite a poem dramatically. You can make it up.

title: Human Pretzel
description: Cross your arms and legs and hop 5 times.

title: Storyteller
description: Start a story with one sentence and go around the circle.

title: Movie Quotes
description: Recite a famous movie quote using a funny accent.

title: Name 5
description: Name 5 countries in exactly 5 seconds.

title: Statue
description: Freeze completely like a statue for 30 seconds.

title: Pantomime
description: Pantomime making a sandwich without using words.

title: The Floor is Lava
description: Keep your feet off the floor for the next minute.

title: Quick Math
description: Answer a math question provided by the group.

title: Secret Handshake
description: Invent a complex handshake with the person to your left.

title: Compliment Time
description: Give a genuine compliment to every player in the room.

title: Sell Me This Pen
description: Try to sell a random object to the group in 30 seconds.
